pronunciationNote: PEH-loo k VAY-zhoo, oo oh-RAH-ryoo pah-REH-s ah-pair-TAH-doo, poor EE-soo tal-VEHZ preh-SEE-z d oom PLAH-noo al-tair-nah-TEE-voo

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não gosto de depender de uma ligação demasiado justa.
exampleSentences.english: I do not like depending on a connection that is too tight.

subject: Transport & Public Transit

exampleSentences.portuguese: Assim consigo visualizar melhor o percurso.

subject: Transport & Public Transit
english: If there is a simpler route that locals usually take, I would rather follow that one.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Nem sempre a opção teórica é a melhor na prática.
exampleSentences.english: The theoretical option is not always the best in practice.

subject: Transport & Public Transit

pronunciationNote: gosh-TAH-vah d eh-vee-TAR kom-PRAR oo bee-LYEH-t eh-RAH-doo ee soh pair-SEH-bair EE-soo doo-RAN-t ah fee-skah-lee-zah-SOWN

exampleSentences.portuguese: Por isso prefiro confirmar tudo antes.
